controls.why: Dafermos 2005 is Einstein-Maxwell-real-scalar; T-501 caveat says 'Matter model is EM-scalar, not vacuum'.
Christodoulou 1999 is scalar-field collapse; D-007 assumption is Einstein-Maxwell-real-scalar.
Holonomy paper covers RN-Vaidya / EM-scalar; T-304 caveat says 'Matter model is EM-scalar, not vacuum'.
Van de Moortel is Einstein-Maxwell-Klein-Gordon (charged scalar).
Kerr-de Sitter: Einstein vacuum equations WITH Lambda > 0 is outside the frozen Lambda = 0 class.
Kerr stability paper: asymptotically flat solutions of the Einstein vacuum equations (EVE), Lambda = 0.
Row excerpt: 'satisfying the vacuum Einstein equations with singular boundaries', no symmetry.
Schwarzschild stability: 'solutions to the Einstein vacuum equations ... general vacuum initial data'.
Schwarzschild C^0-inextendibility: lexicon fallback (exact Kerr/Schwarzschild data live in X_vac).
synthetic matter-model statement must map to a scope error.
synthetic vacuum statement must map to licensed.
absence of a model statement must never be read as licensed.
a one-byte mutation of a pinned file must fail the sha256 gate.
universe size is fixed by the pinned ledger bytes, not by the classifier.
